name: Heavenly Realms
overview: Scripture reveals the heavenly realms as the spiritual domain created by God at the beginning, distinct from the earthly realm (Genesis 1:1). Jesus promises eternal life and presence in paradise for believers, affirming the reality of a heavenly existence beyond this life (Luke 23:43; John 3:16). God, being Spirit, requires worship in spirit and truth, underscoring the unseen, spiritual nature of the heavenly realm where true communion with Him occurs (John 4:24). Christ’s invitation to follow Him into this realm challenges believers to embrace the fullness of life He offers, both now and forever (John 6:55, 6:67).
